programs.title: Man v Food
programs.desc: Adam Richman travels around the United States to face the greatest culinary challenges.It covers the route from Boston to Seattle.He also goes to any other place where he can overeat.

programs.title: Mexico Life 3
programs.desc: The creators of the program follow people looking for their perfect home in Mexico.Most of them dream of constant sun, beautiful beaches and water sports.Some people are looking for an entertaining nightlife, while others are looking for the traditional cuisine of the region.There are also many people who want to live in a secluded and quiet place on the coast.Local real estate agents will help them make a choice and find their own place in Mexican paradise.In each episode, specialists will present the characters with numerous offers from the real estate market, both the more expensive ones, but ready to move in, and the cheaper ones, but requiring renovation.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc:
Martyna Wojciechowska once again sets out on a fascinating journey to learn about different aspects of the lives of women living in distant corners of the world.Some of the points of the route in this edition will be India, Senegal, South Korea, South Africa, Israel and Mexico.The program participants will talk about their everyday lives and reveal intimate secrets to the traveler.Some of them will be truly moving.This season, the journalist will look at how the Orthodox Jewish community functions on a daily basis and how they celebrate the joyful holiday of Purim.He will visit a nursing home for women who were once involved in prostitution.Although this profession is legal in Mexico, women are not entitled to any benefits.The traveler will also meet teenage Karolina, who works almost 24 hours a day at a garbage dump, and in South Africa she will meet a girl who dives with sharks.These are just some of the many amazing experiences that await Martyna Wojciechowska
Martyna Wojciechowska goes to South Africa, where she visits an unusual teenager, Ella Addison.Her greatest passion is diving with sharks.She first jumped into water full of predators when she was five years old.It was her parents, Gail and Mark, who taught the girl how to dive.Together with her godmother - Julie Andersen, the founder of Shark Angels, an organization that saves sharks - they also instilled in Ella their love for the ocean and these animals.The teenager is the voice of the young generation on saving the world.In 2018, as many as 150 million sharks were killed.Traders obtain their fins, which are the basic ingredient of the most expensive soup in the world.They throw the rest into the ocean, leaving the fish to die.Representatives of this species, on the one hand, have the worst reputation of all animals, and on the other hand, they are greatly underestimated.If they became extinct, the ecosystem would be disturbed.
